entries.averment: The claim falls within the scope of Order XXXVII (written contract, bill of exchange, promissory note, or a liquidated demand arising from an enactment).
For an instrument-based claim, the instrument (bill/note/written contract) is identified.
The plaint states that it is filed under Order XXXVII.
The plaint states that no relief outside the scope of Order XXXVII is claimed.
The plaint states that a summons for judgment will follow institution and that the defendant has no right to defend without leave.
Cause of action (date and place), jurisdiction (both limbs), limitation and the reconciled account are pleaded, as in an ordinary plaint.

source.ref: O7 CPC (shared with the ordinary plaint)
